cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Dance terminology is the specialist vocabulary used to describe, analyse and evaluate movement accurately

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Action content refers to what the body does: travel, turn, jump, gesture, stillness, transfer of weight

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Dynamic content describes how the body moves: fast/slow, sudden/sustained, strong/light, direct/indirect

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Spatial content describes where the body moves: levels, directions, pathways, formations, personal and general space

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Relationship content describes who the body moves with: unison, canon, contact, contrast, complement, leader-follower

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Accurate use of terminology is essential for both written exam answers and NEA written tasks

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: AQA expects precise vocabulary — words like 'fast' should be refined to 'sudden' or 'quick' depending on context

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Action words are the foundation: every movement can be categorised as one of the six action content types

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Dynamic words add quality and character to movement descriptions, distinguishing between efforts and energies

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Spatial words locate movement in the performance space and describe the dancer's relationship to it

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Relationship words describe interactions between dancers and are key to analysing group choreography

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Terminology & Action Words
cards.back: Using the four content categories ensures your appreciation is thorough and covers all aspects of the dance

cards.front: What should you know about gcse dance exam tips — dance terminology & action words?
cards.back: 1. For Dance Terminology & Action Words questions, identify the relevant area of law and state the legal principles clearly 2. Apply legal rules to the facts of the scenario — don't just state the law 3. When evaluating, consider both the effectiveness and fairness of legal rules 4. Reference relevant cases and statutes when discussing Dance Terminology & Action Words 5. Consider reform proposals and alternative approaches where relevant
